an7.76:1.1: sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hoti.
an7.76:1.7: ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso
an7.76:1.8: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.76:1.9: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.76:1.10: imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hotīti.
